message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 15 November 2026 23:40 UTC to 16 November 2026 23:40 UTC (16 November 05:10 to 17 November 05:10 IST).
**Scope:** Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt only, combined with obvious aliases deduplicated. Ubuntu package notices issued on 16 November report fixes for previously disclosed vulnerabilities; they are new vendor updates, not necessarily new CVEs. Canonical's notice pages give dates rather than publication times.

### Ubuntu SoS: CVE-2026-79655

**Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 7.8; Ubuntu priority medium. A crafted archive processed by sos clean can create or overwrite arbitrary files through improperly validated links. The newly published [Ubuntu advisory](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9093-1) covers sos/sosreport packages including Ubuntu 22.04, which is in the inventory. Confirm the package is installed and review the applicable fix.

### Ubuntu GStreamer: Four vulnerabilities

**Severity:** Not stated in the advisory. [USN-9094-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-9094-1) covers CVE-2026-85150 (crafted RTSP messages can cause denial of service), CVE-2026-86476 (video data may cause denial of service or code execution), CVE-2026-119729 (crafted AV1 media can cause denial of service), and CVE-2026-119842 (a crafted subtitle file can cause denial of service when opened). Affected Ubuntu releases differ by CVE; Ubuntu 22.04 is included for all except CVE-2026-86476. Check installed GStreamer packages and the advisory's release-specific fixes.

### Ubuntu Net-SNMP: CVE-2026-89147

**Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 7.5; Ubuntu priority medium. An unauthenticated remote connection to the SMUX service can cause Net-SNMP to stop responding. Canonical's [new notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8997-2) extends fixes to Ubuntu 20.04, 18.04, 16.04 and 14.04; Ubuntu is monitored, but those particular releases and Net-SNMP deployment must be confirmed. SMUX is not enabled by default on Ubuntu, according to the [CVE record](https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-89147).

### MongoDB ecosystem

The dedicated search reviewed MongoDB's security alerts and searched for Server, mongod/mongos, Atlas, management tools, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors, BI, Charts, Realm/App Services, integrations and vendor-owned advisories, alongside CVE/NVD, GitHub, CISA and security research sources. No fresh relevant finding was verified in the window. [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

**Closing:** Review the Ubuntu advisories promptly against actual releases and installed packages, prioritizing the high-scored SoS and Net-SNMP issues where applicable. This search is not a guarantee of complete coverage; ambiguous inventory entries were not treated as confirmed products.
